posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Is your game called "output"?
If not your path is missing one folder name....
I asked for the full path because MV creates HTML5-based games, and originally if a number of special (and forbidden) signs or letters are in the foldername then the browser can't load them.
And the Windows-Override that forces a browsers (like the exe of your project) to accept spaces doesn't always work...

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
ElvenNeko said:
The second option will miss out some of the files almost every time, i don't know why.
Click to expand...
because the editor has no knowledge of what files the plugins use, unless said plugins register them with the javascript function (which most plugin programmers do not use at al).
a workaround is to make a hidden and unused map where you use all the resource files from plugins with event commands, that way the editor knows them as well.
As for the encryption problem, it is again a plugin issue - there are two different functions, one to load encrypted files and one for regular files. Plugins that use the function to load regular files directly will fail to load encrypted files. The entire engine itself uses the correct load if encrypted and has no problems there.
So the problem can be caused by plugins as well if the OP uses encryption, but that is more difficult to solve (I started with the more common causes above)
